description: Gold-standard labeled queries. Your classifier's routing decision must match expected_agent. Entity matching is subset + normalized (see fixtures/README.md for matching rules).

agent_taxonomy.portfolio_health: structured assessment of the user's current portfolio — concentration, P&L, diversification, benchmarking
agent_taxonomy.market_research: factual or recent information about a specific instrument, sector, index, or market event
agent_taxonomy.investment_strategy: action-oriented advice — should I buy/sell/hold/hedge/rebalance, allocation guidance
agent_taxonomy.financial_calculator: deterministic numerical computation — DCA returns, compound interest, mortgage, FX conversion, tax estimates
agent_taxonomy.risk_assessment: risk metrics, exposure analysis, stress tests, what-if downside scenarios
agent_taxonomy.portfolio_recommendations: recommend specific products or funds that suit the user's profile or goal
agent_taxonomy.predictive_analysis: forward-looking analysis — forecasts, price targets, trend extrapolation, outlook
agent_taxonomy.support: platform issues, account questions, billing, how-to-use-app, onboarding

entity_vocabulary.tickers: array of strings, uppercase, exchange-suffixed where relevant (AAPL, ASML.AS, 7203.T)
entity_vocabulary.topics: array of free-form strings describing concepts mentioned
entity_vocabulary.sectors: array of strings (technology, healthcare, energy, financials, consumer_staples, utilities, real_estate, industrials, materials, communication_services)
entity_vocabulary.amount: number, in the unit implied by context (USD unless currency is set)
entity_vocabulary.frequency: one of: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly
entity_vocabulary.index: canonical name (S&P 500, FTSE 100, NIKKEI 225, MSCI World, Nasdaq)
entity_vocabulary.action: one of: buy, sell, hold, hedge, rebalance
entity_vocabulary.goal: one of: retirement, education, house, FIRE, emergency_fund
